release_label: Early Beta 15 - Shared building is available now
graphic_title: The road to a shared MMO world.
overview_intro: Coverage in [Early Beta 15](https://github.com/DooDesch/MMORPGTycoon2-Multiplayer/releases/tag/v0.1.0-beta.15). The current focus is one Host and one friend building a small world. Partial means only the listed parts are supported.

features.name: Steam lobbies
features.scope: Host a lobby or join a friend's session from the Multiplayer window.

features.name: A shared world
features.scope: The Host creates or loads a world; the joining player receives it.

features.name: Session chat
features.scope: Basic session messages in the Multiplayer window.

features.name: Buildings and scenery
features.scope: Place, move and remove supported buildings and individual scenery objects.

features.name: Terrain and roads
features.scope: Paint forest terrain, place roads and remove roads. More terrain tools and path types are planned.

features.name: Regions
features.scope: Share region purchases, biome styles and region levels.

features.name: Pause and game speed
features.scope: Keep the same pause state and simulation speed.

features.name: Research
features.scope: Start Bridges research, assign workers and unlock it together. Other research is not covered by this overview.

features.name: NPC placement
features.scope: Place, move and remove Class Trainers and Quest Givers. Broader NPC gameplay is a next priority.

features.name: Elite monsters
features.scope: Place, move and remove individual Elite monsters while paused. Live monster gameplay is a next priority.

features.name: Save and resume
features.scope: Continue from the Host's saved world. Wider support for saved objects is a next priority.

features.name: More quests and combat
features.scope: More quest tools and live monster gameplay are in development for future releases.

features.name: Four players and larger worlds
features.scope: The current focus is two-player co-op in small worlds.
